hens_rule_text: Up to 4 hens allowed with an annual permit from Richmond Animal Care and Control; no roosters.
permit_notes: An annual permit from Richmond Animal Care and Control (RACC) is required, with a $60 fee.
setback_notes: Chickens, pens, fenced areas or coops may not be located within 15 ft of any adjacent dwelling.
coop_rules: Coop and enclosure standards set out in RACC's chicken-keeping guide; birds must be confined to the owner's property.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: City of Richmond Animal Care and Control, A Guide to Owning Chickens in Richmond (official PDF)

research_notes: The city's own RACC chicken guide PDF (confirmed reachable, 200 OK) is quoted in search-result extracts giving the 4-hen cap, no-rooster rule, $60 annual permit and 15 ft setback from an adjacent dwelling; the PDF text itself could not be extracted on this machine and the exact code section was not identified. Some secondary aggregator sites wrongly claim 6 or 8 hens; those were rejected in favor of the official guide.
